::: {.hero}
Earth is dying. In the twenty-second century it launches hundreds of Genesis
seedships toward every star within reach — each carrying frozen embryos and a
guardian intelligence with the whole of human knowledge aboard.

Each ship raises a first generation, seeds a colony, and goes to sleep.

Thirteen thousand years later, their children have forgotten Earth, rediscovered
each other, built an empire, and lost it. This is their history.
:::

## The two halves

**[The Chronicles](chronicles/index.qmd)** is the fiction — the stories of people
living inside this history, who mostly do not know they are inside it.

**[The Galactic Encyclopedia](encyclopedia/index.qmd)** is the world itself: the
drives, the wormhole network, the habitability scale, the ships, the worlds, the
long argument between what physics permits and what people attempt anyway.
